# LOGOS — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 1
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 1-2 | Coptic
**Chapter:** 1

---

[Pages 1-6 of the manuscript are lost. The text begins mid-conversation in chapter 5. Chapters 1-4 are entirely absent from the Coptic manuscript. No Greek fragment recovers this portion. The original opening of the Gospel of Mary is unrecoverable.]

---

*Translator's Note (LOGOS):* The lacuna is total for these pages. LOGOS renders no speculative content. The reader is directed to chapter 5, where the surviving text commences.
